objectives: Discuss and recall knowledge in a shared setting.

interaction.progression: Player order advances through the selected rounds. Ranking is by points; tie handling and free play are supported.
interaction.help: The in-app instructions explain moderation and scoring. In wheel mode, Continue to question confirms the selected category. Exit saves the session for later.

tutorial.title: Set up the group
tutorial.text: Enter 2–12 player names. Choose one category or the wheel, then 3, 5 or 10 rounds, or free play.

tutorial.title: Confirm the topic
tutorial.text: For wheel mode, spin and wait for the selected category. Tap Continue to question.

tutorial.title: Read and answer aloud
tutorial.text: The moderator reads the question. The current player answers verbally; players do not need separate devices.

tutorial.title: Reveal or request a hint
tutorial.text: Reveal the answer and mark Correct or Incorrect. A hint instead reveals four choices and allows one scored selection for reduced points.

tutorial.title: Continue and finish
tutorial.text: Review the explanation and score, then move to the next player. Review the ranking at the end, or exit to save the game.
